description: Telemetry invoke bridges (usage + crash), split out of `default` and platform-scoped: `tauri-plugin-aptabase` and `tauri-plugin-sentry` are both gated off the iOS target in Cargo.toml (#587 — the App Store privacy label "Data Not Collected" relies on the SDKs not even linking there), and a capability referencing a permission from a plugin that isn't built fails the build outright.
